players/warrior/skills/whirling_axes.sva.name: Whirling Axes
players/warrior/skills/whirling_axes.sva.description: You throw two spinning axes that deal Physical damage to all enemies in their paths.

upgrades.name: Revolving Axes
upgrades.description: The axes now returns to you after a period.

upgrades.name: Burning Axes
upgrades.description: The axes deal additional Fire damage.

upgrades.name: Culling Axes
upgrades.description: The axes gain a chance to instantly kill an enemy on Low Life. Does not work on Bosses.

players/warrior/skills/warcry.sval.name: War Cry
players/warrior/skills/warcry.sval.description: You and all allies in the area gain a buff that increases Weapon and Movement Speed for a period.

upgrades.name: Intimidating Cry
upgrades.description: Enemies around you are inflicted by Weakness when casting War Cry.

upgrades.name: Second Wind
upgrades.description: You regain a portion of your Health when casting War Cry.

upgrades.name: Battle Cry
upgrades.description: You gain stacks of Killing Spree for each enemy around you when casting War Cry.

players/warrior/skills/constitution.sval.name: Warrior's Constitution
players/warrior/skills/constitution.sval.description: Increases your Health and Poison Resistance.

upgrades.name: Combat Training
upgrades.description: You deal increased damage with Melee skills.

upgrades.name: Toughness
upgrades.description: You take less damage.

upgrades.name: Mighty Strength
upgrades.description: Increases your Armor Penetration.

players/warrior/skills/killing_spree.sva.name: Killing Spree
players/warrior/skills/killing_spree.sva.description: You gain stacks of Killing Spree by killing enemies. Each stack increases your damage. You lose all stacks at once if the duration runs out.

upgrades.name: Brutality
upgrades.description: Each stack now also grants Weapon and Spell Crit Chance.

upgrades.name: Killer Physique
upgrades.description: Each stack increases your Health Regen.

upgrades.name: Dauntless
upgrades.description: Melee hits against Bosses and Elites gain a chance to add stacks of Killing Spree.

players/warrior/skills/berserker_leap.sv.name: Leap
players/warrior/skills/berserker_leap.sv.description: You leap towards the target location, landing with a slam dealing Physical damage and inflicting Stun to enemies in the area.

upgrades.name: Trembling Impact
upgrades.description: After landing you set off a series of tremors that erupt after a short delay, dealing additional Physical damage.

upgrades.name: Fiery Leap
upgrades.description: You ignite the ground at the location form where you leap and land, dealing Fire damage for period of time.

players/warrior/skills/berserker_rage.sv.name: Rage
players/warrior/skills/berserker_rage.sv.description: Taking damage will grant you a temporary Rage buff for a period, increasing your Crit Chance and Crit Damage with Physical skills.

upgrades.name: Unyielding Rage
upgrades.description: You automatically gain rage when on Low Life, you also take less damage when on Low Life.

upgrades.name: Furious Cry
upgrades.description: You gain Rage when casting War Cry. Your cooldowns are also reduced during Rage.

players/warrior/skills/primalist_totem.s.name: Ancient Totems
players/warrior/skills/primalist_totem.s.description: You place a totem at the target location that deals Physical damage to nearby enemies for a period.

upgrades.name: Shock Totems
upgrades.description: The totems periodically shock nearby enemies dealing Lightning damage. If the totems are placed close to eachother they create barriers of lightning between them dealing additional damage.

upgrades.name: Frostbite Totems
upgrades.description: Changes the damage type to Ice and gains a chance to inflict Freeze.

players/warrior/skills/primalist_strikes.name: Tremor Strikes
players/warrior/skills/primalist_strikes.description: Your Melee Weapon attacks cause tremors around you dealing Mainhand damage in the area. This effect has a short cooldown.

upgrades.name: Tempest Strikes
upgrades.description: Your Melee Weapon hits gain a chance to deal additional Lightning damage to the target and a random different nearby enemy.

upgrades.name: Glacial Strikes
upgrades.description: Your Melee Weapon hits gain a chance to trigger a small explosion dealing additional Ice damage. This effect has a short cooldown.

players/warrior/skills/tyrant_chains.sva.name: Chains
players/warrior/skills/tyrant_chains.sva.description: You throw out chains all around you, dealing Physical damage and inflicting enemies with Cripple.

upgrades.name: Barbed Chains
upgrades.description: The chains now inflict stacks of Bleeding.

upgrades.name: Spiked Chains
upgrades.description: Spike projectiles are now released at the end of the chains.

players/warrior/skills/tyrant_passive.sv.name: Ruthlessness
players/warrior/skills/tyrant_passive.sv.description: You deal increased Physical damage and your Physical skills gain a chance to inflict stacks of Bleeding.

upgrades.name: Exploding Gibs
upgrades.description: Killing enemies with Physical skills have a chance to trigger an explosion of gibs dealing Physical damage and applying Bleeding in the area.

upgrades.name: Slayer
upgrades.description: You deal increased damage to enemies based on their missing health.

players/paladin/skills/pal_blessed_strik.name: Blessed Strike
players/paladin/skills/pal_blessed_strik.description: You strike all enemies in the area in front of you, dealing Physical damage.

upgrades.name: Massive Strike
upgrades.description: Increases the size of the strike area.

upgrades.name: Purging Flames
upgrades.description: The strike area erupts in flames dealing additional Fire damage for a period.

upgrades.name: Wrathful Strike
upgrades.description: Deals additional Lightning damage that can chain to other nearby enemies.

players/paladin/skills/pal_lay_on_hands..name: Lay on Hands
players/paladin/skills/pal_lay_on_hands..description: You heal yourself and all allies around you.

upgrades.name: Invigorating Touch
upgrades.description: Also applies a buff that increases Health and Mana Regen for a short period.

upgrades.name: Cleansing Touch
upgrades.description: Removes all Debuffs and Afflictions. You also gain immunity to all Debuffs for a short period.

upgrades.name: Turn Undead
upgrades.description: Deals Physical damage to all Undead enemies in the area.

players/paladin/skills/pal_shining_knigh.name: Armored Knight
players/paladin/skills/pal_shining_knigh.description: Increases your Armor, and grants a chance to block 100% Physical damage.

upgrades.name: Elemental Bulwark
upgrades.description: Increases your Fire, Ice and Lightning resistances.

upgrades.name: Glancing Blows
upgrades.description: You gain an additional chance to block 100% of any damage type.

upgrades.name: Armor of Wrath
upgrades.description: You gain a chance to strike a random nearby enemy with a bolt of lightning when taking damage, dealing Lightning damage based on your Armor value.

players/paladin/skills/pal_conviction.sv.name: Conviction
players/paladin/skills/pal_conviction.sv.description: Your Melee Weapon hits have a chance to restore some of your Mana.

upgrades.name: Resolve
upgrades.description: While you are below half health your Spells cost less mana.

upgrades.name: Shield of Faith
upgrades.description: While you have more than half of your maximum mana left, you block damage for a cost of mana.

upgrades.name: Zeal
upgrades.description: When Conviction triggers you deal additional Physical damage based on your current Mana.

players/paladin/skills/pal_judgement.sva.name: Judgement
players/paladin/skills/pal_judgement.sva.description: You pass judgement on random nearby enemies for a duration, striking them with a divine hammer dealing Physical damage.

upgrades.name: Prolonged Prosecution
upgrades.description: While Judgement is active you gain a chance to extend the duration when killing enemies. The duration cannot be extended to more than 7 seconds.

upgrades.name: Hammer of Wrath
upgrades.description: Deals additional Lightning damage.

players/paladin/skills/pal_lawbringer.sv.name: Lawbringer
players/paladin/skills/pal_lawbringer.sv.description: When you block or take damage you have a chance to inflict Disarm and Silence to the attacker.

upgrades.name: Punish the Wicked
upgrades.description: Hitting an enemy afflicted with a Status strikes them with a Judgement hammer.

upgrades.name: Shackles
upgrades.description: Weapon and Spell hits gain a chance to shackle the target and a different nearby enemy. Shackled enemies have reduced movement speed and take continuous Physical damage.

players/paladin/skills/divine_pillars.sv.name: Divine Pillars
players/paladin/skills/divine_pillars.sv.description: You summon pillars of heavenly light to explode at your location, dealing Physical damage and inflicting Blindness.

upgrades.name: Divine Pattern
upgrades.description: Causes additional pillars to strike in succession in a grid like pattern. The pillars deal half as much damage with each consecutive strike.

upgrades.name: Pillars of Wrath
upgrades.description: Deals additional Lightning damage.

players/paladin/skills/divine_protection.name: Divine Protection
players/paladin/skills/divine_protection.description: Taking damage when below half health has a chance to grant you a buff of Invulnerability for a brief period. This effect has a cooldown.

upgrades.name: Restoration
upgrades.description: You gain a massive increase to Health Regen while you have the buff.

upgrades.name: Divine Retort
upgrades.description: When you gain the buff you automatically cast Divine Pillars.

players/paladin/skills/radiance_immolati.name: Immolation
players/paladin/skills/radiance_immolati.description: You charge up a massive explosion that is unleashed when you release the spell, dealing Fire damage to all enemies around you.

upgrades.name: Fuel the Flame
upgrades.description: Casting Immolation now increases your Fire damage for a duration.

upgrades.name: Blazing Lance
upgrades.description: You now unleash a blazing lance projectile that deals additional Fire damage to all enemies in its path.

players/paladin/skills/radiance_flames.s.name: Inner Flames
players/paladin/skills/radiance_flames.s.description: Casting Spells generate stacks of Inner Flames. While you have stacks of Inner Flames you gain an aura dealing Fire damage to nearby enemies.

upgrades.name: Flames of Devotion
upgrades.description: Each stack of Inner Flames adds Fire damage per your character level to your weapons.

upgrades.name: Bringer of Flames
upgrades.description: Each stack of Inner Flames increases your Fire Resistance and Fire Penetration.

players/ranger/skills/ran_marked_shot.sv.name: Marked Shot
players/ranger/skills/ran_marked_shot.sv.description: You fire a projectile that deals Physical damage and applies Marked to all enemies in the targeted area. You deal more damage to enemies inflicted by Marked.

upgrades.name: Hot Pursuit
upgrades.description: You gain a short buff of increased Movement Speed when hitting Marked targets.

upgrades.name: Thrill of the Hunt
upgrades.description: Killing enemies inflicted by Marked has a chance to restore some of your Health and Mana.

upgrades.name: Big Game Hunter
upgrades.description: You deal additional damage to Bosses and Elites inflicted by Marked.

players/ranger/skills/ran_trap.sval.name: Trap
players/ranger/skills/ran_trap.sval.description: Throws a trap that deploys after a brief duration. The traps deal Physical damage in a small area when triggered and inflict Cripple.

upgrades.name: Multiple Deploy
upgrades.description: You deploy additional traps with each cast.

upgrades.name: Serrated Traps
upgrades.description: The traps now inflict stacks of Bleeding.

upgrades.name: Frost Traps
upgrades.description: The traps deal additional Ice damage.

players/ranger/skills/ran_rhythm.sval.name: Rhythm
players/ranger/skills/ran_rhythm.sval.description: You gain Weapon Crit Chance, and scoring Weapon Crits grant you stacks of Rhythm. Each stack of Rhythm increases your Weapon Crit Chance and Weapon Crit Damage.

upgrades.name: In the Flow
upgrades.description: Each stack of Rhythm increases your Weapon Speed.

upgrades.name: Efficiency
upgrades.description: Each stack of Rhythm reduces your Mana costs.

upgrades.name: Momentum
upgrades.description: You gain a stack of Rhythm when dashing.

players/ranger/skills/ran_survivalist.sv.name: Survivalist
players/ranger/skills/ran_survivalist.sv.description: Each time you get hit you gain a buff that reduces damage taken for a short period. This effect has a short cooldown.

upgrades.name: Evasive Maneuver
upgrades.description: Also grants Evasion for the duration of the buff.

upgrades.name: Tactical Maneuver
upgrades.description: You gain a Dash Charge when taking damage. This effect has a short cooldown.

upgrades.name: Quick Recovery
upgrades.description: Increases your Health Regen for the duration of the buff.

players/ranger/skills/marksman_rain_of_a.name: Rain of Arrows
players/ranger/skills/marksman_rain_of_a.description: You launch a barrage of arrows into the air that strike the ground in a forward direction, dealing Physical damage.

upgrades.name: Storm of Arrows
upgrades.description: Increases the impact area.

upgrades.name: Thundercaller
upgrades.description: The arrows are followed by a sequence of lightning strikes, dealing Lightning damage.

players/ranger/skills/marksman_archery.s.name: Archery
players/ranger/skills/marksman_archery.s.description: The movement speed penalty for using Bow & Crossbow skills is reduced, and you deal increased damage with Bow & Crossbow skills.

upgrades.name: Fast Shot
upgrades.description: You gain increased skill speed with Bow & Crossbow skills.

upgrades.name: Frost Arrows
upgrades.description: Your Bow & Crossbow skills gain a chance to trigger a frost explosion on hit, dealing Ice damage. This effect has a short cooldown.

players/ranger/skills/beasts_spirit_wolv.name: Spirit Wolves
players/ranger/skills/beasts_spirit_wolv.description: You unleash spirit wolves that seek out nearby enemies, dealing Physical and Ice damage on impact.

upgrades.name: Relentless Hunters
upgrades.description: The spirit wolves gain a chance to seek out a new target on hit.

upgrades.name: Restless Spirits
upgrades.description: You gain a chance to unleash a spirit wolf when killing enemies. This effect has a short cooldown.

players/ranger/skills/beasts_wolf_compan.name: Wolf Companion
players/ranger/skills/beasts_wolf_compan.description: You passively summon a wolf companion to fight by your side that attacks nearby enemies dealing Physical damage.

upgrades.name: Wolf Pack
upgrades.description: You summon additional wolves.

upgrades.name: Winter Wolf
upgrades.description: Your wolves deal additional Ice damage and inflict Slow.

players/ranger/skills/nature_entangle.sv.name: Entangle
players/ranger/skills/nature_entangle.sv.description: You conjure roots to sprout in a large area around you that lingers for a duration. Enemies in the area take Physical damage and are inflicted by Cripple.

upgrades.name: Healing Wisps
upgrades.description: The roots spawn wisps that attaches to allies entering the area, restoring Health for a period.

upgrades.name: Poison Ivy
upgrades.description: Deals additional Poison damage.

players/ranger/skills/nature_wind_weaver.name: Wind Weaver
players/ranger/skills/nature_wind_weaver.description: Weapon hits unleash a gusts of wind in a forward direction dealing Mainhand damage. This effect has a short cooldown.

upgrades.name: Winter Winds
upgrades.description: The gusts of wind deal additional Ice damage.

upgrades.name: Wind Runner
upgrades.description: You unleash several gusts of wind in all directions when dashing.

players/wizard/skills/wiz_magic_missiles.name: Magic Missiles
players/wizard/skills/wiz_magic_missiles.description: Discharges several magic missiles that seek out nearby enemies and deal Physical damage on impact.

upgrades.name: Missile Barrage
upgrades.description: Fires additional projectiles per cast.

upgrades.name: Rebounding Missiles
upgrades.description: The projectiles gain the ability to jump to additional targets on hit.

upgrades.name: Concussive Impacts
upgrades.description: The projectiles gain a chance to inflict Stun.

players/wizard/skills/wiz_fireball.sval.name: Fireball
players/wizard/skills/wiz_fireball.sval.description: Unleash a fireball towards the targeted location that explodes dealing Fire damage.

upgrades.name: Enhanced Fireball
upgrades.description: Increases the size of the explosion.

upgrades.name: Blastwave
upgrades.description: Enemies hit by the fireball are inflicted by Vulnerability.

upgrades.name: Bouncing Fireball
upgrades.description: The fireball now bounces and triggers an explosion with each bounce.

upgrades.name: Savant
upgrades.description: Reduces your spell cooldowns.

upgrades.name: Arcane Weaponry
upgrades.description: You deal increased damage with Arcane weapons.

upgrades.name: Learning
upgrades.description: Increases your Experience Gain.

players/wizard/skills/wiz_barrier.sval.name: Barrier
players/wizard/skills/wiz_barrier.sval.description: You generate protective stacks of Barrier over time. When taking damage a stack is expended, lowering the damage taken.

upgrades.name: Flame Shield
upgrades.description: Taking damage while having stacks of Barrier ignites the air around yourself for a duration, dealing Fire damage to nearby enemies.

upgrades.name: Frost Shell
upgrades.description: As long as you have stacks of Barrier you have increased Armor and Ice Resistance. You also inflict Freeze to any attackers.

upgrades.name: Protective Warding
upgrades.description: Casting a Spell gains a chance to generate stacks of Barrier. This effect has a short cooldown.

players/wizard/skills/wiz_meteor_shower..name: Meteor Shower
players/wizard/skills/wiz_meteor_shower..description: You summon meteors to fall in the area for a duration, dealing both Physical and Fire damage.

upgrades.name: Burning Ground
upgrades.description: The meteors create an area of burning ground on impact, dealing additional Fire damage for a period.

upgrades.name: Comet
upgrades.description: Increases the damage, changes its type to Ice and Physical, and gains a chance to inflict Freeze.

players/wizard/skills/wiz_incanters_flow.name: Incanter's Cadence
players/wizard/skills/wiz_incanters_flow.description: Casting Spells generate stacks of Incanter's Cadence. Each stack increases your Cast Speed and reduces the Mana Cost of spells.

upgrades.name: Rising Crescendo
upgrades.description: Each stack of Incanter's Cadence increases your Spell Crit Chance.

upgrades.name: Incanter's Flow
upgrades.description: Each stack of Incanter's Cadence increases your Weapon Speed.

players/wizard/skills/conjuration_hydras.name: Conjure Hydras
players/wizard/skills/conjuration_hydras.description: You conjure multiple hydra that spew fire at nearby enemies dealing Fire damage.

upgrades.name: Greater Hydra
upgrades.description: You conjure additional hydra heads with each cast.

upgrades.name: Frost Breath
upgrades.description: Changes damage type to Ice.

players/wizard/skills/conjuration_sword..name: Animated Sword
players/wizard/skills/conjuration_sword..description: You conjure a magical sword that follows you around at all times. The sword slashes at nearby enemies dealing Physical damage.

upgrades.name: Flame Blade
upgrades.description: The sword is now engulfed in flames and continously deals Fire damage to nearby enemies.

upgrades.name: Ice Blade
upgrades.description: The sword now deals Ice damage and gains a chance to inflict Freeze.

players/wizard/skills/transmutation_hast.name: Haste
players/wizard/skills/transmutation_hast.description: You gain a temporary buff that increases your Weapon, Cast and Movement Speed.

upgrades.name: Blur
upgrades.description: You also gain Evasion for the duration of the buff.

upgrades.name: Temporal Shift
upgrades.description: For the duration of the buff you inflict nearby enemies with Slow.

players/wizard/skills/transmutation_body.name: Enhanced Physique
players/wizard/skills/transmutation_body.description: Grants additional Strength and Dexterity per character level.

upgrades.name: Enhanced Strength
upgrades.description: Grants Spell Power per Strength.

upgrades.name: Enhanced Dexterity
upgrades.description: Grants Spell Power per Dexterity.

upgrades.name: Free Movement
upgrades.description: You gain immunity to Slow and Cripple.

players/rogue/skills/rog_fan_of_knives.s.name: Fan of Knives
players/rogue/skills/rog_fan_of_knives.s.description: Throws several knives in a cone dealing Physical damage.

upgrades.name: Ricochet
upgrades.description: The projectiles now bounce off walls and collisions. Each bounce reduces speed and damage.

upgrades.name: Deadly Aim
upgrades.description: You gain increased crit chance with Fan of Knives.

upgrades.name: Poisoned Knives
upgrades.description: Deals additional Poison damage.

upgrades.name: Focused Throw
upgrades.description: You throw fewer projectiles in a forward direction. The projectiles deal more damage and have a slightly longer lifetime.

players/rogue/skills/rog_flurry.sval.name: Flurry of Blades
players/rogue/skills/rog_flurry.sval.description: You perform a series of strikes, hitting all enemies in an area around you, dealing Mainhand Weapon damage.

upgrades.name: Disarming Strikes
upgrades.description: Gains a chance to inflict Disarm.

upgrades.name: Fiery Bolas
upgrades.description: Bolas are applied to each target hit plus an additional nearby enemy. Enemies affected are slowed and take Fire damage for a period.

upgrades.name: Shock Assault
upgrades.description: Deals additional Lightning Damage

players/rogue/skills/rog_slice_and_dice..name: Slice and Dice
players/rogue/skills/rog_slice_and_dice..description: Hits with Melee skills grant stacks of Slice and Dice. Each stack increases your Weapon Speed. You lose all stacks at once if the duration runs out.

upgrades.name: Adrenaline
upgrades.description: Each stack increases your Mana Regen.

upgrades.name: Blade Parry
upgrades.description: Each stack increases your Parry.

upgrades.name: Agile Casting
upgrades.description: Each stack increases your Cast Speed, and you also gain stacks by casting Spells.

players/rogue/skills/rog_evasion.sval.name: Sidestep
players/rogue/skills/rog_evasion.sval.description: Grants Evasion and a single stack of guaranteed evasion that is recharged every few seconds.

upgrades.name: Fleet Footed
upgrades.description: Increases your Movement Speed.

upgrades.name: Lethal Opening
upgrades.description: Grants additional Crit Chance for a short period after evading.

upgrades.name: On the Move
upgrades.description: Dashing gains a chance to recharge the guaranteed evasion of Sidestep.

players/rogue/skills/blades_mortal_strik.name: Mortal Strike
players/rogue/skills/blades_mortal_strik.description: You deliver a quick deadly strike that deals massive Mainhand Weapon damage.

upgrades.name: Phantasmal Strike
upgrades.description: The strike now chains to additional enemies in a cone behind the target. Deals less damage for each consecutive enemy hit.

upgrades.name: Crimson Strike
upgrades.description: You gain a small amount of Life Leech with Mortal Strike.

players/rogue/skills/blades_assassin.sva.name: Assassin
players/rogue/skills/blades_assassin.sva.description: Increases your Weapon Crit Damage and reduces the range of enemies detecting you.

upgrades.name: Executioner
upgrades.description: You gain a chance to instantly kill an enemy on Low Life when scoring crits with Melee skills. Does not work on Bosses.

upgrades.name: Hidden Cuts
upgrades.description: Attacking with Melee weapons strikes a random nearby enemy for Mainhand Weapon damage.

players/rogue/skills/poison_toxic_cloud..name: Toxic Cloud
players/rogue/skills/poison_toxic_cloud..description: You deploy a large toxic cloud that lingers for a period. The cloud blocks enemy vision and deals Poison damage to any enemies inside the cloud.

upgrades.name: Billowing Cloud
upgrades.description: You and your allies gain Evasion while inside the cloud.

upgrades.name: Corrosion
upgrades.description: Enemies entering the cloud are inflicted by Armor Break.

players/rogue/skills/poison_mastery.sval.name: Poison Mastery
players/rogue/skills/poison_mastery.sval.description: You deal increased Poison damage and your Poison skills gain a chance to inflict Vulnerability.

upgrades.name: Coated Weapons
upgrades.description: Adds Poison damage to your weapons per character level.

upgrades.name: Deadly Toxins
upgrades.description: Increases your Poison Penetration and Poison Resistance.

players/rogue/skills/demolitions_grenade.name: Grenade
players/rogue/skills/demolitions_grenade.description: You throw a grenade in forward direction that detonates after a brief period, dealing Physical damage.

upgrades.name: Incendiary Grenades
upgrades.description: The grenade now explodes on impact and leaves an area of burning ground for a short period, dealing Fire damage.

upgrades.name: Shock Grenades
upgrades.description: The grenade deals additional Lightning damage that can chain to other nearby enemies.

upgrades.name: Explosive Exit
upgrades.description: If you start a dash near an enemy you drop a grenade. This effect has a short cooldown.

players/rogue/skills/demolitions_artific.name: Artificer Suit
players/rogue/skills/demolitions_artific.description: Increases your Armor and Physical damage. Taking damage causes a flashbang to trigger inflicting nearby enemies with Blindness. This effect has a short cooldown

upgrades.name: Zzzap
upgrades.description: Weapon skills has a chance to trigger a lightning bolt to zap a random nearby enemy, dealing Lightning damage.

upgrades.name: Shrapnels
upgrades.description: Casting spells has a chance of discharging multiple shrapnels in all directions, dealing Physical and Fire damage.

players/warlock/skills/demons_tail.sval.name: Demon's Tail
players/warlock/skills/demons_tail.sval.description: Conjures a diabolical whip to lash out in a forward direction, dealing Physical damage and inflicting Slow.

upgrades.name: Crackling Lash
upgrades.description: Crackling arcs of lightning are discharged at nearby enemies, dealing Lightning damage.

upgrades.name: Fiery Lash
upgrades.description: Flames erupt along the lash that lingers for a short period, dealing Fire damage.

upgrades.name: Heavy Impact
upgrades.description: Enemies hit by the end of the whip are now also inflicted by Stun.

players/warlock/skills/dark_ritual.sval.name: Dark Ritual
players/warlock/skills/dark_ritual.sval.description: You start performing a ritual that completes after a few seconds. Enemies take Physical damage while inside the area and even more damage when it completes. The ritual is terminated if you leave the area before it is completed.

upgrades.name: Blood Ritual
upgrades.description: Enemies inside the area now has a chance to be inflicted with stacks of Bleeding.

upgrades.name: Conflagration
upgrades.description: The damage type is changed to Fire and the ritual deals even more damage when it is completed.

upgrades.name: Leeching Ritual
upgrades.description: You and your allies gain Life Leech while inside the area.

players/warlock/skills/drain_essence.sva.name: Drain Essence
players/warlock/skills/drain_essence.sva.description: You gain stacks of Essence when hitting enemies with Melee skills. Each stack increases your max Health and Mana. This effect has a short cooldown.

upgrades.name: Life Siphon
upgrades.description: When you gain stacks of Essence you restore a percentage of your Health.

upgrades.name: Energy Siphon
upgrades.description: When you gain stacks of Essence you restore a percentage of your Mana.

upgrades.name: Drain Blood
upgrades.description: You now also inflict stacks of Bleeding to the targets you gain Essence from.

upgrades.name: Essence Harvester
upgrades.description: You gain a chance to gain stacks of Essence when killing enemies.

players/warlock/skills/aura.sval.name: Aura of Atrophy
players/warlock/skills/aura.sval.description: You project an aura around you that makes enemies deal less damage.

upgrades.name: Agony
upgrades.description: Enemies in your aura also take more damage.

upgrades.name: Spreading Corruption
upgrades.description: Melee weapon hits deal additional Poison damage to a different nearby enemy.

upgrades.name: Spontaneous Combustion
upgrades.description: Casting a Spell deals Fire damage to all enemies affected by your aura.

players/warlock/skills/summon_fiends.sva.name: Summon Fiends
players/warlock/skills/summon_fiends.sva.description: Channel the spell to summon fiends by consuming stacks of Essence. Fiends attack nearby enemies, dealing Physical damage.

upgrades.name: Infernal Fiends
